project_type: Windows DLL (d3d11 proxy) for Guild Wars 2 translation overlay
build_system: CMake + vcpkg, MSVC, Windows x64 only. Uses CMakePresets.json with 'windows-msvc' and 'windows-msvc-debug' presets. CI runs on windows-latest.
test_framework: None - no test infrastructure exists. Validation is done by confirming the DLL compiles without errors.
build_command: Cannot build on this Linux host (requires MSVC + vcpkg on Windows). Validate via static analysis of code structure and CMake syntax.
verification_instructions: 1. Verify CMakeLists.txt syntax is valid. 2. Verify all source files compile conceptually (no missing includes, no unresolved references between files). 3. Verify .def file exports match the extern C functions declared. 4. Verify the architecture: DllMain only loads real d3d11.dll, hooks are installed lazily from proxied_D3D11CreateDevice.
setup_instructions: Windows-only project. Requires: Visual Studio 2022, vcpkg, CMake 3.21+. Build with: cmake --preset windows-msvc && cmake --build build/windows-msvc --config Release
environment_constraints: This is a Windows-only project (DX11, MSVC). We are on a Linux host so we cannot actually compile the code. Verification must be done through code review, checking CMake syntax validity, and ensuring consistency between .def exports and function declarations.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing code patterns - namespace bronco::*, RAII, OutputDebugStringA for logging, Windows API conventions.
key_patterns: Namespace hierarchy: bronco::proxy, bronco::hook, bronco::overlay, bronco::pipeline, bronco::ocr, bronco::translation, bronco::Config. Singleton pattern (Config, Pipeline). Anonymous namespaces for file-local state. VTable hooking for IDXGISwapChain. Proxy pattern: .def file maps export names to proxied_* functions which forward to real DLL.
directory_structure: Root: CMakeLists.txt, vcpkg.json, CMakePresets.json. src/: all C++ sources organized by module (proxy/, hook/, overlay/, pipeline/, ocr/, translation/, config/, cache/). config/: runtime JSON config. data/: dictionaries and tessdata. scripts/: install/uninstall batch files. docs/: documentation. .github/workflows/: CI.
